# prx — CLI reference

<!-- GENERATED by `bun packages/prx/scripts/gen-cli-docs.ts` from the prx command registry (src/cli/registry.data.ts). Do not edit by hand — edit the registry and regenerate (`bun run cli:render`). Not a hard CI gate (the command set grows on main faster than a branch can track); regenerated on main by the auto-docs-PR workflow and unit-tested by test/cli/docs.test.ts. -->

`prx` exposes **243** commands across 4 domains,
owned by **16** actors. Each command is a registry entry; the
CLI, MCP toolset, help text, and this page are all projections of it.
